text_version.version: BOCG Congreso, Serie A, núm. 97-1, 12 June 2026: Proyecto de Ley Orgánica para el buen uso y la gobernanza de la inteligencia artificial (121/000096)
text_version.note: The anteproyecto (Council of Ministers 11 Mar 2025, audiencia pública 18-26 Mar 2025) became a Proyecto de Ley Orgánica approved by the Government 26 May 2026 and published in the BOCG 12 Jun 2026 (amendment deadline 30 Jun 2026); registry title/stage are outdated. Includes exposición de motivos. Page headers/cve stamps and BOCG cover note removed from the .txt.

territorial_scope.description: National law applying to AI systems introduced on the market, put into service or used in Spanish territory, with regional data protection authorities designated within their competences.

evidence.quote: aplicable a los sistemas de IA introducidos en el mercado, puestos en servicio y utilizados en territorio español

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Draft Spanish organic law that would designate national AI authorities (notifying authority and market surveillance authorities, led by AESIA), create an AI regulatory sandbox, impose public-sector AI inventory and officer duties, and set a sanctions regime with fines for breaches of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 by AI systems used in Spain.
summary.long: Draft organic law for the good use and governance of AI, adapting Spanish law to Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act). Chapter I sets the object, definitions and scope for providers, deployers, manufacturers, importers, distributors and notified bodies, covering AI systems placed on the market or used in Spanish territory. Chapter II designates the notifying authority (Dirección General de Inteligencia Artificial) and market surveillance authorities (AESIA by default, plus data protection, financial, judicial and electoral-process designations), a single point of contact, a complaints channel and whistleblower protection. Chapter III requires AESIA to set up an AI regulatory sandbox. Chapter IV imposes duties on the Spanish state public sector: information on AI use, a national AI systems inventory and an AI delegate. Chapter V classifies infringements as very serious, serious or minor, with maximum fines of EUR 35 million or 7% of worldwide turnover (prohibited practices), EUR 15 million or 3%, EUR 7.5 million or 1%, and EUR 500,000 or 0.5% (minor), plus limitation periods, provisional measures and coercive fines. Final provisions amend tax, social security and electoral laws. Enters into force the day after BOE publication.

notes: Draft bill (anteproyecto) text: the final provisions contain placeholders ('Ley orgánica XX/2026, de XX de XXX de 2026' in disposición final segunda). Internal inconsistencies: art. 40(1)-(2) set a 25 % reduction for voluntary payment, but art. 40(3) refers to a 50 % reduction for payment without a further stated rule; art. 4(2) cross-refers to 'artículo 35 de esta ley' (sanctioning procedure) for supervision of notified bodies; art. 13(2) classifies the art. 99.4 infringements as muy graves, graves or leves, while art. 30(1)(a)-(b) map penalties to muy graves under art. 13.1 and 13.2 only. Preamble references (e.g., Real Decreto 729/2023, Real Decreto 210/2024, Ley 12/2021, Reglamento (UE) 2016/679 in the recitals) are context and not coded. The section_status fields are populated only because the schema requires them; relations and entities contain entries.

obligations.summary: Confidentiality duties under Art. 78 of the Regulation must be guaranteed in all market surveillance or sanctioning action.

evidence.quote: se deberán garantizar los deberes de confidencialidad exigidos en el artículo 78

obligations.summary: Market surveillance authorities must exchange any operational information needed for coordination, taking into account incidents and information exchanged in the AI Board and Commission guidelines.

evidence.quote: se suministrarán e intercambiarán cualquier información operativa que asegure la adecuada coordinación

obligations.summary: Market surveillance authorities inform about serious incidents under Arts. 73 and 76, about evaluation, corrective and provisional measures under Arts. 79 and 80 (where the infringement exceeds national territory or a system is high-risk), and about findings under Art. 82, subject to the Art. 74.4 exclusion.
obligations.conditional_on: Subject to exclusion in Art. 74.4 of the Regulation; some items depend on cross-border or risk conditions

evidence.quote: Informarán sobre los incidentes graves, de acuerdo con los artículos 73 y 76

obligations.summary: Where a high-risk AI system presents a risk to public health or fundamental rights, the market surveillance authority must notify the risk within a maximum of ten working days to the competent ministries and rights authorities, who must issue a mandatory report within the same period.
obligations.conditional_on: Compliant high-risk system presents risk to public health or fundamental rights

evidence.quote: notificarán el riesgo detectado en un plazo no superior a diez (10) días hábiles

obligations.summary: Market surveillance authorities use the information system of Art. 34 of the Market Surveillance Regulation to exchange data on application of the AI Regulation and other product safety law.

evidence.quote: harán uso del sistema de información y comunicación del artículo 34

obligations.summary: AESIA promotes effective collaboration among market surveillance authorities for risk prevention and application of the supervision regime.

evidence.quote: La AESIA fomentará la efectiva colaboración de las actuaciones de las autoridades de vigilancia del mercado

obligations.summary: A collegiate body, the Comisión mixta de colaboración entre autoridades de vigilancia del mercado, is created to exchange information and good practice; AESIA chairs it and provides its secretariat, and it must publish its operating rules.

evidence.quote: se creará, como órgano colegiado, la Comisión mixta de colaboración entre autoridades de vigilancia del mercado

obligations.summary: Market surveillance authorities exchange information on their activities for the annual report under Art. 5(5) and (6) of the Regulation, and transfer documentation to the authority supervising fundamental rights obligations where risks to fundamental rights are detected.
obligations.conditional_on: Where fundamental rights risks are detected

evidence.quote: intercambiarán información sobre las actividades que realicen para garantizar la elaboración del informe anual

obligations.summary: Any natural or legal person with grounds to consider the Regulation has been breached may submit a complaint to the competent market surveillance authority under Art. 85 of the Regulation; complaints do not confer interested-party status in sanctioning proceedings.
obligations.conditional_on: Grounds to consider a breach of the Regulation

evidence.quote: podrá presentar una reclamación ante la autoridad de vigilancia del mercado competente

obligations.summary: AESIA establishes a single window for complaints and must forward them to the competent surveillance authorities within a maximum of ten working days from receipt.

evidence.quote: La AESIA establecerá un sistema de ventanilla única para la presentación de dichas reclamaciones

obligations.summary: Persons who report, through the channels of Directive (EU) 2019/1937 and Law 2/2023, infringements of the Regulation or of this law, in a work or professional context, are entitled to the protection of that law by the Autoridad Independiente de Protección del Informante or regional authorities.
obligations.conditional_on: Reports made through the channels of Directive (EU) 2019/1937 and Law 2/2023

evidence.quote: tendrán derecho a la protección establecida en dicha norma

obligations.summary: AESIA is the competent authority responsible for establishing the one sandbox that is mandatory under Art. 57.1 of the Regulation.

evidence.quote: La AESIA será la autoridad competente responsable de establecer el espacio controlado de pruebas para la IA de obligada creación

obligations.summary: Additional AI regulatory sandboxes may be created by at least one competent authority (notifying or market surveillance) within its own competence; market surveillance authorities for Annex I section B products may also create them where requirements have been integrated into their harmonisation acts.
obligations.conditional_on: Within the authority's competence; Annex I section B products under Art. 2.2 of the Regulation

evidence.quote: deberá ser llevada a cabo por, al menos, una autoridad competente designada en los artículos 4 y 5 de la presente ley

obligations.summary: The authority responsible for a sandbox must inform the AI Office and AI Board through the single point of contact, demonstrate sufficient resources, submit annual reports under Art. 57.16 of the Regulation through the single point of contact, and make those reports public from the start of operation.

evidence.quote: la autoridad competente deberá acreditar la asignación de recursos suficientes para el desarrollo del espacio controlado de pruebas para la IA

obligations.summary: Coordination of the AI sandboxes must include the authorities that define public policy in the sectors concerned and, where relevant, the authorities protecting fundamental rights.

evidence.quote: En la coordinación de los espacios controlados de pruebas para la IA se deberá incluir a las autoridades responsables de definir las políticas públicas

obligations.summary: Entities of the state public sector must provide relevant and up-to-date information on their use of AI systems in exercising their functions; Art. 12(4) excludes military, national security, critical infrastructure, research, cybersecurity, access-to-information and fraud-prevention systems.
obligations.conditional_on: Art. 12(4) exemptions apply to listed systems

evidence.quote: Las entidades que forman el sector público estatal deberán ofrecer información pertinente y actualizada sobre la utilización de sistemas de IA en el ejercicio de sus funciones

obligations.summary: An inventory of AI systems for the state public sector, interoperable with the EU high-risk registry under Art. 49 of the Regulation, must be prepared; for each algorithm or AI system the information must include at least the provider, deployer, other operators and the categorisation of the system.

evidence.quote: se elaborará un inventario de sistemas de IA para el sector público estatal interoperable

obligations.summary: Information on AI systems used to prevent and control tax fraud must be incorporated into the inventory only in a manner compatible with the confidential nature of the tax control plan, and must not allow those systems to be known, reproduced, inferred or circumvented.
obligations.conditional_on: Information on AI systems used for tax fraud prevention

evidence.quote: sin que pueda incluirse información que permita conocer, reproducir, inferir o eludir dichos sistemas

obligations.summary: State public sector entities must promote awareness, dissemination and training on responsible, sustainable and trustworthy development and use of AI within their scope.

evidence.quote: Las entidades del sector público estatal promoverán, en su ámbito, actuaciones dirigidas a la concienciación

obligations.summary: Each state public sector entity must designate an AI delegate for internal policy development and compliance; the delegate advises on impact assessments under Art. 23.1 of Law 15/2022 and Art. 27 of the Regulation; the delegate must be a career civil servant, or permanent employee with AI and regulatory expertise, with functions set by regulation.
obligations.conditional_on: Where the entity has competences over AI systems

evidence.quote: Cada entidad del sector público estatal deberá designar, en el ejercicio de sus competencias, a un delegado de IA

obligations.summary: Competent authorities exercising sanctioning power must observe proportionality between sanction and infringement, weighing factors listed in Art. 31(1)(a) to (j), including harm to health, safety and fundamental rights, duration, cooperation and recidivism.

evidence.quote: Las autoridades competentes, en el ejercicio de su potestad sancionadora, deberán guardar la debida proporcionalidad entre la sanción y el hecho constitutivo de la infracción

obligations.summary: Competent authorities must communicate to AESIA the sanctions imposed, the facts constituting the infringements, the identity of the offender where a legal person, and the progress of related litigation, safeguarding confidentiality under Art. 78 of the Regulation.

evidence.quote: Las autoridades competentes comunicarán a la AESIA las sanciones impuestas

obligations.summary: AESIA must publish the sanctions imposed by all market surveillance authorities within a maximum of 15 working days from receiving the communication; published resolutions must exclude personal data and confidential matters.

evidence.quote: La AESIA publicará en un plazo no superior a 15 días hábiles desde la comunicación

obligations.summary: AESIA, as single point of contact, must communicate to the European Commission the administrative sanctions imposed each year under this law and related litigation, under Art. 99.11 of the Regulation, and to the AI Board where applicable under Art. 101.4.

evidence.quote: La AESIA, en calidad de punto de contacto único, comunicará a la Comisión Europea las sanciones administrativas

obligations.summary: Sanctioning proceedings are initiated ex officio and must be resolved within eighteen months for very serious and serious infringements and nine months for minor ones; the authority must issue a reasoned final resolution stating whether an infringement exists.

evidence.quote: El plazo para resolver en estos procedimientos será de dieciocho meses en los expedientes por infracciones muy graves y graves

obligations.summary: Persons within the subjective scope of the law must deal with the competent authority by electronic means under Art. 14(2) of Law 39/2015.

evidence.quote: Los sujetos comprendidos en el ámbito subjetivo de esta norma deberán relacionarse con el órgano competente por medios electrónicos

obligations.summary: For public sector entities and constitutional bodies that commit infringements, the market surveillance authority must issue a resolution declaring the infringement and issuing a formal warning, with corrective measures, excluding administrative fines under Art. 99.8 of the Regulation; the resolution must be notified to the entity and its hierarchical superior.
obligations.conditional_on: Infringement committed by a public sector entity or constitutional body

evidence.quote: dictará resolución declarando la infracción, apercibiendo a la entidad u órgano actuante

obligations.summary: The Government must promote the regulatory initiative to adapt AESIA into a public law entity, with separate legal personality, own assets, management autonomy and administrative power, and must ensure its independence and resources.
obligations.applies_from: Within six months from entry into force of this law

evidence.quote: el Gobierno impulsará la correspondiente iniciativa normativa para la adaptación de la Agencia Española de Supervisión de Inteligencia Artificial

obligations.summary: Algorithmic, automated and AI systems used in the prevention and control of tax fraud are reserved: they must not be made public, communicated or accessible, nor disclosed to taxpayers or to bodies outside tax application, where disclosure could compromise enforcement.
obligations.conditional_on: Where disclosure could compromise the effectiveness of tax enforcement actions

evidence.provision: Disposición final primera (art. 116.3 Ley 58/2003, as inserted)
evidence.quote: no será objeto de publicidad, comunicación o acceso público

obligations.summary: The social security management entities must cooperate with the competent market surveillance authority for AI systems, supplying strictly necessary data to identify those responsible for infringements where identification by other means has failed, under Art. 5 of the law.
obligations.conditional_on: Identification of responsible persons by other means has not been possible

evidence.provision: Disposición final segunda (art. 77.1.p Ley General de la Seguridad Social, as inserted)
evidence.quote: La colaboración con la autoridad de vigilancia del mercado competente

obligations.summary: AESIA is designated as market surveillance authority for high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III point 8 used in democratic processes (systems intended to influence election or referendum outcomes or voting behaviour), excluding campaign administration tools; and for Annex III point 1 biometric systems used in democratic processes, excluding biometric verification-only systems.

evidence.provision: Disposición final tercera (Disposición adicional novena, Ley Orgánica 5/1985, as inserted)
evidence.quote: Se designa a la AESIA como autoridad de vigilancia de mercado de los siguientes sistemas de IA de alto riesgo

obligations.summary: The Government is empowered to adopt all regulations necessary for the development and application of the law (regulatory development power).

evidence.quote: Se faculta al Gobierno para que pueda dictar cuantas disposiciones sean necesarias

obligations.summary: A royal decree must regulate the national database for registering high-risk AI systems associated with critical infrastructure under Annex III point 2 of the Regulation, as provided by Art. 49.5 of the Regulation.

evidence.quote: Se regulará mediante real decreto la base de datos nacional para el registro

obligations.summary: The national critical-infrastructure AI registry database is to be jointly managed by the designated market surveillance authority and the Secretaría de Estado de Seguridad, in accordance with rules on critical entities and classified matters.

evidence.quote: Esta base de datos será gestionada de forma conjunta entre la autoridad de vigilancia del mercado designada

enforcement.authority: Autoridades de vigilancia del mercado competentes (art. 5)
enforcement.triggered_by: Infracciones muy graves recogidas en el artículo 13.1 (prácticas de IA prohibidas, art. 14)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: hasta 35.000.000 euros o, si el infractor es una empresa, hasta el 7 % de su volumen de negocios mundial total correspondiente al ejercicio anterior, si esta cuantía fuese superior

enforcement.authority: Autoridades de vigilancia del mercado competentes (art. 5)
enforcement.triggered_by: Infracciones muy graves recogidas en el artículo 13.2 (incumplimientos del art. 99.4 Reglamento classified as very serious in arts. 15 to 29, e.g. art. 15 incident notification)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: hasta 15.000.000 euros o, si el infractor es una empresa, hasta el 3 % de su volumen de negocios mundial total correspondiente al ejercicio anterior, si esta cuantía fuese superior

enforcement.authority: Autoridades de vigilancia del mercado competentes (art. 5)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Infracciones graves: hasta 7.500.000 euros o, si el infractor es una empresa, hasta el 1 % de su volumen de negocios mundial total correspondiente al ejercicio anterior, si esta cuantía fuese superior
enforcement.penalty_formula: Companies: 1 % of total worldwide turnover of the preceding financial year, if higher than 7,500,000 euros

evidence.quote: Infracciones graves: hasta 7.500.000 euros o, si el infractor es una empresa, hasta el 1 % de su volumen de negocios mundial total correspondiente al ejercicio anterior, si esta cuantía fuese superior.

enforcement.authority: Autoridades de vigilancia del mercado competentes (art. 5)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Infracciones leves: hasta 500.000 euros o, si el infractor es una empresa, hasta el 0,5 % de su volumen de negocios mundial total correspondiente al ejercicio anterior, si esta cuantía fuese superior
enforcement.penalty_formula: Companies: 0.5 % of total worldwide turnover of the preceding financial year, if higher than 500,000 euros

evidence.quote: Infracciones leves: hasta 500.000 euros o, si el infractor es una empresa, hasta el 0,5 % de su volumen de negocios mundial total correspondiente al ejercicio anterior, si esta cuantía fuese superior.

enforcement.authority: Autoridad de vigilancia del mercado competente
enforcement.triggered_by: Non-compliance with the corrective measures ordered in the sanctioning resolution after the deadline set in it has passed (coercive fines)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: La cuantía de cada multa no superará un 10 % de la multa fijada por la infracción cometida.
enforcement.penalty_formula: Each coercive fine at most 10 % of the fine set for the infringement; may be repeated for successive periods (art. 30.5)
enforcement.cure_period: Deadline set in the requirement, which may not be less than one month (art. 30.5)

evidence.quote: La cuantía de cada multa no superará un 10 % de la multa fijada por la infracción cometida.

enforcement.authority: Autoridad de vigilancia del mercado competente
enforcement.triggered_by: Very serious infringements for prohibited AI practices, and infringements where an AI system caused a serious incident (art. 3.49), where the authority finds the system an unacceptable or serious risk
enforcement.max_penalty_text: podrá imponerse adicionalmente la retirada del producto, la desconexión del sistema de IA o su prohibición
enforcement.penalty_formula: Additional measure: product withdrawal, disconnection or prohibition of the AI system

evidence.quote: podrá imponerse adicionalmente la retirada del producto, la desconexión del sistema de IA o su prohibición

enforcement.authority: Autoridad de vigilancia del mercado competente
enforcement.triggered_by: Persistent failure to remedy formal obligations under art. 83 Reglamento (UE) 2024/1689 (high-risk systems)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: la autoridad de vigilancia del mercado adoptará en la resolución sancionadora las medidas necesarias para restringir o prohibir la comercialización del sistema de IA de alto riesgo
enforcement.penalty_formula: Measures to restrict or prohibit marketing of the high-risk AI system, or to recover or withdraw it from the market without delay

evidence.quote: la autoridad de vigilancia del mercado adoptará en la resolución sancionadora las medidas necesarias para restringir o prohibir la comercialización del sistema de IA de alto riesgo

enforcement.authority: Autoridad de vigilancia del mercado competente
enforcement.triggered_by: Presumed infringement, during or before proceedings, to prevent the spread of harm (non-exhaustive list); pre-proceedings measures may not exceed three months (art. 37.2)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Impedir la comercialización de un sistema de IA que se encuentra en la cadena de suministro.
enforcement.penalty_formula: Provisional measures: require adaptation, prevent marketing, return or disable the system, alert end users

evidence.quote: Impedir la comercialización de un sistema de IA que se encuentra en la cadena de suministro.

enforcement.authority: Autoridad de vigilancia del mercado competente
enforcement.triggered_by: Minor infringements, where the subject has completed all corrective measures within the deadline and acknowledged responsibility
enforcement.max_penalty_text: La resolución incorporará una advertencia formal sin naturaleza disciplinaria ni efectos sancionadores adicionales
enforcement.penalty_formula: Formal warning, not published, with no additional sanctioning effects
enforcement.cure_period: Corrective measures within the deadline set by the sanctioning body (art. 38.1)

evidence.quote: La resolución incorporará una advertencia formal sin naturaleza disciplinaria ni efectos sancionadores adicionales

enforcement.authority: Autoridad de vigilancia del mercado competente
enforcement.triggered_by: Infringements committed by public sector entities and constitutional or constitutionally relevant bodies
enforcement.max_penalty_text: apercibiendo a la entidad u órgano actuante, y estableciendo, en su caso, las medidas que proceda adoptar
enforcement.penalty_formula: Declaration of infringement and warning, with measures to cease the conduct or correct its effects; administrative fines excluded
enforcement.cure_period: Measures set in the resolution to cease the conduct or correct its effects

evidence.quote: apercibiendo a la entidad u órgano actuante

enforcement.triggered_by: Notified body that fails its obligations or no longer meets the requirements of art. 31 Reglamento (UE) 2024/1689
enforcement.max_penalty_text: limitará, suspenderá o retirará la designación, según el caso,
enforcement.penalty_formula: Designation limited, suspended or withdrawn, depending on the severity of the non-compliance, after an administrative procedure with a hearing

evidence.quote: limitará, suspenderá o retirará la designación, según el caso,

enforcement.triggered_by: Facts that may constitute a criminal offence during the sanctioning procedure
enforcement.max_penalty_text: pasará el tanto de culpa al órgano jurisdiccional competente
enforcement.penalty_formula: Referral to the criminal court; the sanctioning procedure is suspended until a final judicial ruling; no criminal penalty is set in this text

evidence.quote: pasará el tanto de culpa al órgano jurisdiccional competente

enforcement.triggered_by: Infractor acknowledges responsibility after a sanctioning procedure has been initiated, or pays voluntarily before the resolution
enforcement.max_penalty_text: el órgano sancionador competente aplicará una reducción del 25 % sobre el importe de la sanción propuesta.
enforcement.penalty_formula: 25 % reduction of the proposed fine; reductions are cumulative (art. 40.3); payment with a 50 % reduction counts as acknowledgement

evidence.quote: el órgano sancionador competente aplicará una reducción del 25 % sobre el importe de la sanción propuesta.

enforcement.triggered_by: Dissolution without liquidation or global transfer of assets and liabilities of a legal person
enforcement.max_penalty_text: las medidas correctivas, sanciones pecuniarias y multas coercitivas pendientes de las mismas se transmitirán a las personas jurídicas o entidades que sucedan
enforcement.penalty_formula: Pending corrective measures, fines and coercive fines pass to the successor or beneficiary entity

evidence.quote: las medidas correctivas, sanciones pecuniarias y multas coercitivas pendientes de las mismas se transmitirán a las personas jurídicas o entidades que sucedan
